source: convention: Meadows row, staggered stance side-on to a landmine bar, right foot forward with the right hand braced on the right knee, torso about 75 degrees from vertical, the left hand rows the bar end from a straight hang to beside the hip with the elbow flared up and out, the trunk turning a little open towards the rowing side at the top (trunkTwist 0 to 10: the braced arm turns with the trunk, its hand drifting a few centimetres off the knee); angles UNSOURCED
